svg.text: STRANDS — the two leads are the two saturated ribbons
Normal People — the same braid on the novel’s own clock

Eighteen chapters, January 2011 to February 2015. Column spacing tracks elapsed time: a month is a fixed width, longer gaps widen, and the two chapters that happen days and minutes apart sit almost on top of their predecessors.
Two chapters refuse the pattern: “Two Days Later” and “Five Minutes Later” sit almost on top of the chapter before them. Rooney elides three, four, six months; she will not elide these.
